scope: Public-wall isolation (no PII leak), throttling, branch enumeration probe, multi-tenant cross-branch IDOR, OSS Sanctum exemption
framing: Score whether the public unauthenticated wall endpoint exposes any PII or cross-branch surface. Confirm session-A C-016 + Round-2 heals preserve security posture.

evidence.admin_route: routes/api.php:1032-1035 — Route::prefix('oss-order')->name('ossOrder.') group is inside auth:sanctum + permission:order-status-screen

resource_payload.popular_resource: CDSPopularItemResource — id/name/currency_price/thumb only (already public via /api/frontend/item/popular-items per controller docstring lines 105-110)

branch_isolation.admin_path: OrderStatusScreenOrderService::resolveBranchScope() at line 245-263 — branch staff with mismatched branch_id query param → abort(403); global Admin (branch_id=0) → null scope.
branch_isolation.public_path: OrderStatusScreenController::publicIndex line 76-99 + publicMostPopularItems line 111-135 — accept ?branch_id=N query param OR fall back to first ACTIVE branch.
branch_isolation.sentinel: tests/Feature/Sentinels/OssAdminBranchPolicySentinelTest.php exists (verified) — covers branch staff cannot request global

findings.title: Public wall PII surface — verified empty
findings.evidence: CDSOrderDetailsResource.php toArray() returns exactly {id, order_serial_no, token, queue_number, order_type, status}. No PII fields. order_serial_no is a server-allocated sequence (NF525 invariants) — disclosure is acceptable per controller docstring lines 47-74 cited C-016 design rationale.
findings.status: ALREADY-VERIFIED-SAFE — no heal needed. Cited in Agent 4 round-1 §1 + Impl C evidence §1.

findings.title: Public branch enumeration via ?branch_id query param
findings.evidence: publicIndex (line 76-99) accepts any positive integer branch_id without verifying the branch exists or is ACTIVE. Order::where('branch_id', N) returns empty collection for unknown N (not a 404), but response timing or row-count differences could be a probe oracle. Mitigation: throttle:oss-public limiter (verified at app/Providers/RouteServiceProvider.php cited in agent-4 round-1 §1 + routes/api.php:1108). 60/min/IP hard 429.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: ALREADY-FLAGGED-AS-P2-IN-ROUND-1 ([OSS-A-02]). Session-A explicitly deferred to V1.0.2 (per Impl C §7 deferred list).
findings.heal_recommendation: Add Branch::where('id', $branchId)->where('status', Status::ACTIVE)->exists() check before listForBranch() in publicIndex (and mostPopularItems). Return empty collection without DB query if invalid (same response shape — keeps the probe oracle low).
findings.blast_radius: low (throttled, no PII even if probe succeeds, single-branch Le Cayenne not enumerable)

findings.title: No 429 rate-limit regression test for throttle:oss-public
findings.evidence: RouteServiceProvider declares oss-public limiter 60/min/IP (per agent-4-oss round-1 §6 and routes/api.php). No tests/Feature/OSS/OssPublicRateLimitTest.php exists. Confirmed: tests/Feature/OSS/ contains OssCustomerScreenFilterTest.php + OssPolishClusterTest.php only.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: ALREADY-FLAGGED-AS-P2-IN-ROUND-1 (acceptance gate inventory line 51). Session-A did not create the test (marked '(test TO BE CREATED)').
findings.heal_recommendation: Add tests/Feature/OSS/OssPublicRateLimitTest.php — fire 70 requests from same IP within 60s window, assert 60 succeed (200) + 10 return 429.
findings.blast_radius: regression coverage gap, throttle still active in production

findings.title: Multi-tenant whereIn fail-closed allowlist heal preserves NF525 + branch isolation
findings.evidence: OrderStatusScreenOrderService::list() line 59-62 + listForBranch() line 196-199 both apply whereIn('order_type', [KIOSK, TAKEAWAY]). Previous '!= DELIVERY' blacklist could leak POS=15 or DINING_TABLE=20 if they carried a token. Sentinel: tests/Feature/OSS/OssCustomerScreenFilterTest.php (verified exists).
findings.status: ALREADY-HEAL-APPLIED-2026-05-18 via RED R-3 (cited in service comments lines 53-58 + 193-195). No further action.

findings.title: Compiled admin-oss.js is dirty (102 KB) — not in CI build cache
findings.evidence: git diff HEAD public/js/admin-oss.js shows 46+ line WIP from session-A Round-2 Impl C. Mix-manifest also dirty (public/mix-manifest.json in baseline status). This is a session-A artifact (P0-OSS-01 chime gate compiled in). Need to confirm npm run dev/prod was the source — if hand-edited, would be a CI poisoning risk.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: ARTIFACT of session-A. Confirmed by git diff that the change MATCHES the Vue source (authBranchId() <= 0 chime gate + audio-listener wrapping). Mix-compiled output.
findings.heal_recommendation: Phase 2 global convergence step: verify mix-manifest.json hash matches webpack output for admin-oss.js. If hand-edit detected, recompile with npm run dev. Out of Z-2 scope (orchestrator-level).

verdict: AUDIT-ONLY pass. Public-wall PII surface is empty (Z2-SEC-01). Multi-tenant whereIn allowlist heal preserved (Z2-SEC-04). Two pre-existing P2 deferred (Z2-SEC-02 branch probe + Z2-SEC-03 rate-limit test). No new P0/P1 security findings emerge from session-A heal sufficiency review.
